ghul.incrementalAnalysis.markdownDescription: Reuse the analyser’s existing state across an edit instead of rebuilding the whole project for each one. Much faster on a large project, at the cost of some answers being briefly out of date after an edit that changes a declaration. Unset defers to `incremental_analysis` in `ghul.json`, and is otherwise off.

ghul.plaintextHover.markdownDescription: Render hovers as plain text rather than formatted markdown. Unset defers to `want_plaintext_hover` in `ghul.json`, and is otherwise off.

ghul.inlayHints.narrowing.markdownDescription: Show the type-narrowing inlay hints (►/◄ at narrowing sites). Unset keeps the compiler default, which is on. Changing this restarts the analyser.

ghul.inlayHints.definitionVirtuality.markdownDescription: Show the dispatch-hierarchy inlay hints (◆/▲/▼/○ on declarations). Unset keeps the compiler default, which is on. Changing this restarts the analyser.

ghul.inlayHints.terminators.markdownDescription: Show a `∘︎` inlay hint at every statement terminator the parser inferred (left off at end of line). One hint per inferred boundary, so this is dense — pair it with `editor.inlayHints.enabled: offUnlessPressed`. Unset keeps the compiler default, which is off. Changing this restarts the analyser.

scripts.webpack: npm run genversion && npm run clean && webpack --mode production --config ./client/webpack.config.js && webpack --mode production --config ./server/webpack.config.js
scripts.webpack:dev: npm run genversion && npm run clean && webpack --mode none --config ./client/webpack.config.js && webpack --mode none --config ./server/webpack.config.js
scripts.clean: rimraf client/out && rimraf server/out && rimraf language-server/out
scripts.postinstall: cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ..
scripts.test: npm run genversion && npm run test:client && npm run test:server && npm run test:grammar
scripts.test:server: cd server && npm run typecheck && npx jest
scripts.test:integration: npm run genversion && npx webpack --mode production --config ./server/webpack.config.js && cd server && npm run test:integration
